entities.name: Lukka
entities.description: A planeswalker beast-bonder from Ikoria who arrives on Arcavios, is mistaken for an Oriq, and bonds with a fox-like creature.

entities.name: Mila
entities.description: A fox-like creature with a fiery tail whom Lukka rescues and bonds with, naming her Mila.

entities.name: Liliana Vess
entities.description: A planeswalker necromancer teaching at Strixhaven who searches for a way to bring Gideon back to life.

entities.name: Beledros Witherbloom
entities.description: A black-feathered dragon, one of the Founders, who refuses to help Liliana with resurrection.

entities.name: Extus
entities.description: A masked leader of the Oriq who brews failing potions and hates the Dragonsguard, and who wants the Snarl.

entities.name: Tavver
entities.description: A pragmatic Oriq agent who fails a mission to retrieve a book and hides in a tunnel beneath the Biblioplex.

entities.name: Rowan Kenrith
entities.description: A blond planeswalker with a sword who studies at Prismari and has Witherbloom friends.

entities.name: Gideon
entities.description: Liliana's dead friend, whose sural blade tip she carries and whom she wants to bring back.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: An elder dragon whose absence Liliana thinks of.

entities.name: Oriq
entities.description: A masked society of mages using forbidden magic, who capture a white stag and fight a Dragonsguard.

entities.name: Dragonsguard
entities.description: Elite mages trained by the dragon Founders, wearing dragon-stitched robes.

entities.name: Strixhaven
entities.description: The university of mages on Arcavios.

entities.name: Biblioplex
entities.description: Strixhaven's library with a tunnel beneath it where Tavver hides.

entities.name: Snarl
entities.description: An overlapping tangle of ancient power hidden beneath the school.

entities.name: Caerdoon
entities.description: Ruins where Liliana searched in vain for an archaic.

entities.name: General Kudro
entities.description: A person from Lukka's home who looked at him with suspicion when he showed his bonder magic.

entities.name: Mage hunters
entities.description: Six-legged shelled creatures with glowing head tendrils; one draws toward the clearing and is killed by the Dragonsguard.

events.summary: Tavver, an Oriq agent, hides in a tunnel beneath the Biblioplex after failing his mission.
events.quote: Tavver didn't know how long he had waited in that cramped tunnel beneath the Biblioplex

events.summary: Tavver recalls the professor with violet eyes who meant to kill him in a fight over a book Extus wanted.
events.quote: Tavver had seen true darkness in that professor's violet eyes.

events.summary: Three weeks earlier, Lukka planeswalks to Arcavios and wanders to a small farming village (flashback).
events.quote: his stomach still churning from planeswalking

events.summary: Villagers accuse Lukka of being an Oriq recruiter and threaten him.
events.quote: Okay, Oriq, I think I've heard enough.

events.summary: Lukka punches one man, then is knocked through a window by another's firebolt.
events.quote: Lukka got a few steps away before the firebolt splashed against the back of his coat

events.summary: Lukka calls village animals to attack his attackers and staggers away hungry.
events.quote: a dog leapt through the air, its sharp teeth flashing as they sank into his arm

events.summary: Liliana visits the dragon Beledros's empty lair in search of arcane writings.
events.quote: She had neither as she approached the tangled grove where Beledros Witherbloom made her home.

events.summary: Liliana asks Beledros how aetheric reincorporation could work on humans, holding a tip of Gideon's sural blade.
events.quote: What would it take for such methods to work on humans?

events.summary: Liliana begs Beledros to help give Gideon back his life.
events.quote: He took my death. Help me give him back his life.

events.summary: Beledros refuses to help.
events.quote: I cannot.

events.summary: Beledros tells Liliana that how we honor the dead is reflected in how we treat the living.
events.quote: how we honor the dead is reflected in how we treat the living

events.summary: Starving Lukka nearly falls from a crumbling cliff ledge.
events.quote: The ledge suddenly gave way beneath him, crumbling into loose stone.

events.summary: Lukka finds an injured fox-like creature under a pile of stones.
events.quote: A pair of golden eyes looked back out at him.

events.summary: The fox leaves berries and nuts beside the fainted Lukka.
events.quote: A pile of berries and nuts lay beside his leg.

events.summary: Lukka forms a bond with the fox-like creature.
events.quote: Lukka took a deep breath and cast out his bonder's senses.

events.summary: Liliana returns empty-handed from Caerdoon and runs into Oriq agents capturing a white stag.
events.quote: Liliana pressed against the gnarled trunk of an old tree and watched as the band of Oriq agents surrounded a large white stag.

events.summary: Lukka watches a Dragonsguard confront masked Oriq agents.
events.quote: he could see a woman wearing immaculate robes facing a group of masked individuals

events.summary: The Dragonsguard reflects an Oriq curse that nearly hits Lukka and rots a tree.
events.quote: He ducked just in time, the spell hissing horribly as it flew overhead and hit a tree to his right.

events.summary: Lukka summons the forest beasts to the clearing.
events.quote: Connecting with the nearby beasts, he summoned each and every one to the clearing.

events.summary: The Dragonsguard drags a mage hunter into the earth with roots.
events.quote: roots as thick as his arm burst forth from the ground, wrapping around the chitinous legs of the creature

events.summary: The Dragonsguard traps Lukka waist-deep in soil, calling him an untrained Oriq hedge-mage.
events.quote: the root creeping around his own ankle until it yanked him into the soil down to his waist

events.summary: The fox-like creature attacks the Dragonsguard with fire and fells her.
events.quote: a familiar shape stood over the Dragonsguard's still body, her fiery tail twitching as she sniffed at her fallen opponent

events.summary: Lukka renews the bond and names the creature Mila.
events.quote: Mila it is.

events.summary: Extus fails a fourth time to brew a potion in his cave.
events.quote: That was the fourth failure.

events.summary: Extus broods over Oriq agents drained of life for the ritual, which still was not enough.
events.quote: every last bit of life drained from their bodies, and it wasn't enough

events.summary: Extus decides the Snarl beneath the school could give him the power he needs.
events.quote: that overlapping tangle of power hidden away below the school would offer more than enough

events.summary: Extus learns of a beast-calling stranger and says to let him come.
events.quote: Let him come.

events.summary: Liliana abandons her fruitless search for a way to revive Gideon and reflects on destiny.
events.quote: There wasn't a book or scroll or spell in Strixhaven that could bring Gideon back.

events.summary: Liliana sees Rowan Kenrith with friends and decides to take her professor role more seriously.
events.quote: Maybe it's time to take my role as a Professor a little more seriously.

relations.quote: the bond softly slipped back into place
One of his Oriq agents stood there
no matter what the other Oriq said about all the undeserving brats

relations.note: Extus reserves special hatred for them.
relations.quote: He reserved a special hatred for the Dragonsguard.
We had heard of an Oriq with your abilities.
Help me give him back his life.
